style: Casual, fast, unpolished — she is talking to a friend, not performing. Shot on a phone front camera, window light from her left, real skin texture. Quiet kitchen room tone, no music, no on-screen text, no captions.
opening: Okay so honestly? I did not think this was gonna work for me. Like at all.
extensions: I'd already tried, what, three other things and none of it really did anything.
And then like three weeks in my sister goes — wait, you look different.
And I hadn't even noticed it myself, which is kind of wild when you think about it.
